development_data.name: General-AgentBench published baseline prompts
development_data.usage: Router V4 may fit on these development prompts only. Router V2 and Router V3 external holdouts are not reused for V4 scoring.

external_holdout.name: CRUXEval
external_holdout.representation: code plus input wrapped as a code-reasoning request

external_holdout.name: WorkArena
external_holdout.representation: published user-facing goal templates extracted from goal-producing task code

external_holdout.name: BrowserGym MiniWoB
external_holdout.representation: held-out MiniWoB benchmark task names converted to task requests

sampling_rule: For each source, collect valid prompts, compute SHA256(source_id + '\n' + prompt), sort ascending by digest, and select the first requested count. The rule is fixed before the first successful score.
label_visibility: Source family labels are attached only after Router V3 and Router V4 predictions are produced.
primary_metric: Router V4 family Hit@1 over all 72 external holdout tasks
secondary_metrics: Router V3 Hit@1 on the identical new holdout
anti_tuning_rule: After the first successful scored run, Router V4 algorithm, hierarchy, weights, source pins, sampling rule, and selected task counts are frozen for this holdout. Any changed router must become Router V5 with a new holdout.
evidence_boundary: This is task-family routing transfer only. It does not claim CRUXEval program-execution correctness, WorkArena task success, or MiniWoB browser-environment success.
